§6Melter§f

§aMelts items into fluid form.§f
The §bMelter§f takes §b1 item input§f and produces §b1 fluid output§f. Default cycle is §b800 ticks§f at §b40 RF/t§f. It's the reverse of the Ingot Former: solid goes in, liquid comes out. Use it to melt ores, ingots, or other materials into their molten form for fluid-based processing.

The Melter is useful for creating molten metals that can then be cast with the Ingot Former, or for producing fluids needed in chemical recipes.

§ePS:§f The Melter uses more power than most basic machines at 40 RF/t. Make sure your power setup can handle it.
